page.notes: The page begins mid-sentence ("simo illo viro"), a fragment carried over from the previous page. The tilde over the a of "dãmnatus" is read as the abbreviation mark for "mn"; it is uncertain whether it is a tilde or a stray mark. The italic/roman boundaries in the lines "cùm jam damnatus" and "inquit Hieronymus" are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The final line ends with a hyphenated word, "ob-", at the page foot, which continues onto the next page. The printed "Vsserius" is transcribed as "Vsserius" with plain s. No catchword or signature is visible. The faint "Digitized by Google" mark at the bottom right is a digitiser's watermark and is left out.
